about: The audit rows each item of docs/verification/remaining/<key>-result.json is evidence for, read on 2026-10-16 by the coverage area (remaining-fold.cjs reads it). An item whose id is an audit row's maps to that row without an entry here. rows [] means its tests are evidence for no single row's claim, with why. `fragments`: a row-text value an area wrote as a fragment of the field, with what in the field it replaces. `byTest` (from 2026-10-16, brief 09): an area’s tests by a title’s start, each with the rows it reaches, read with what each was read to reach, for an area whose items share tests that reach different rows.

09-journeys.title: DEFECT: a life played to the degree
09-journeys.read: Played to Commencement on 21 May 2029: the Standing, Casting and Coursework tabs rendered after the degree, before and after a reload.

09-journeys.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: a withdrawal in the first fall says how it ended
09-journeys.read: school.withdraw refused unconfirmed and again, the course record kept, the three tabs after it.

09-journeys.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: a student who never prepares her coursework
09-journeys.read: Concern, warning, dismissed at Fall Term 2027’s evaluation by the clock; the tabs after it.

09-journeys.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: a Modest student’s personal leave sends half
09-journeys.read: The leave asked twice and granted, half the scholarship returned; her own transfer into savings; Affiliate cover refused unconfirmed, bought from both accounts, refused again; a part paid, over and nothing refused; the hold and $375 of late fees, one jump against six-hour steps.

09-journeys.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: back for Spring Term 2028 under the hold
09-journeys.read: Notice given and refused twice; registration refused under the hold with nothing moved; paid from both accounts, the hold lifted once; registered, refused again; the first class day counted, through a reload.

09-journeys.title: DEFECT: a doctor’s visit booked at Fair Haven
09-journeys.read: Affiliate cover bought in the lapse says the Fair Haven visit is outside Yale Health; a twin keeps it and is billed as the uninsured; the visit called off and booked again at Yale Health, seen for nothing.

09-journeys.title: DEFECT: withdrawn on 15 February 2027
09-journeys.read: The cover-ended notice of 1 April names 16 May; Enroll refused on 20 May with nothing moved, a twin enrolled on 10 May; the 2026 return filed and refused again.

09-journeys.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: withdrawn in the first fall on 5 October 2026, a citizen
09-journeys.read: The notice names the window’s last day and HUSKY D; Enroll from 1 January, refused again; one jump against six-hour steps.

09-journeys.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: withdrawn on Tuesday 25 August 2026
09-journeys.read: An early withdrawal cancels Yale Health back to 1 August; the notice counts the 60 days from the withdrawal; one jump.

09-journeys.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: an F-1 student from London withdraws
09-journeys.read: Fifteen days’ grace, Out Of Status on 20 October, the notice saying neither the marketplace nor Covered Connecticut takes her; Enroll and the DMV refused in their words; the 1040-NR’s refund once, seventy days on, through a reload.

09-journeys.title: DEFECT: a New Yorker whose one photo ID is her license
09-journeys.read: The license run out says on its Papers row what replaces it (DocumentList; Report Lost isn’t pressed, so documents.report_lost takes nothing); Citi refuses without a photo ID, nothing moved; the Connecticut ID card for $28.00, refused again; the account opened, its $100.00 in transit until it lands, through a reload.

09-journeys.title: DEFECT: a generic filled uninsured on 8 February 2027
09-journeys.read: The fill of 8 February had by the clock’s health week, paid uninsured; Affiliate cover bought back to the lapse’s start reprices the fill at Yale Health’s $10.00 copay, the rest paid back once on a line of its own, through a reload.

09-journeys.title: DEFECT: HUSKY D dropped on Papers on 2 November 2027
09-journeys.read: Drop The Plan pressed on Papers with a renewal’s notice waiting: the notice goes with it, the hardship refused in its words with nothing moved, a second Drop refused; ended on 1 December, nothing renewed, through a reload.

09-journeys.title: GUARD: a renewal’s notice waiting while its program has ended
09-journeys.read: FIXTURE (the program’s end set by hand): the hardship refused in words that say so, nothing moved, Papers drawing no button.

09-judge.title: PLAYER JOURNEY: in the second fall, across a save and a load, casts her as Frau Gabor and him as Hänschen Rilow
09-judge.read: The second fall’s casting played across a save and a load: Spring Awakening’s night read by its long score casts Frau Gabor and Hänschen Rilow (evaluation-10), where it cast Frau Bergmann and Ernst Röbel.
